Navigation

Richiesta autorizzazione per performance di navigazione richiesta

A navigation specification for RNAV operations that requires special aircrew and aircraft authorization before use, typically for advanced RNP approaches and routes.

Questions and answers

What is Richiesta autorizzazione per performance di navigazione richiesta?

In this glossary, Richiesta autorizzazione per performance di navigazione richiesta refers to: A navigation specification for RNAV operations that requires special aircrew and aircraft authorization before use, typically for advanced RNP approaches and routes.

How is Richiesta autorizzazione per performance di navigazione richiesta used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "L’aeromobile deve avere l’autorizzazione per la performance di navigazione richiesta per gli avvicinamenti RNP AR a questo aeroporto."

Definition

A navigation specification for RNAV operations that requires special aircrew and aircraft authorization before use, typically for advanced RNP approaches and routes.

Operational example

Aircraft must have Required Navigation Performance Authorization Required for RNP AR approaches at this airport.

Localized term

Richiesta autorizzazione per performance di navigazione richiesta

Localized example
